findings.summary: Legacy fallback cleanup after successful modern save ignores storage.local.remove errors.
evidence: cm-gtc-client.js line 184 wraps chrome.storage.local.remove(legacyKey, resolve) and never inspects chrome.runtime.lastError.
saveGlobalTranslationCacheEntry returns true immediately after that callback path.
queryGlobalTranslationCache may later serve gtc_<hash> when the modern request fails, so failed cleanup can resurrect stale data.
findings.requested_action: Make cleanup error-aware and add fault-injection regression, coordinated with the 191-029 marker/raw precedence fix.
findings.reason_correction_not_authorized: Distinct ADVERSARIAL decision is still required for the same protected binding.
